denominator_rules.complete: All records in the explicitly stated released family.
denominator_rules.pmc: Observed PMCID or graph PMC route; current availability/OA/reuse/figure/table metadata unknown.
denominator_rules.primary_chains: RESULT native edges with incoming NLM guideline/SR CITES excluding self-links; historical self-inclusive sensitivity retained.
denominator_rules.purposive: Same six query nodes and 18 demonstration paths in neurology, respiratory and cardiovascular areas; not representative samples.

executions.resume_lineage: Fresh published-input census, projections and analytical tables; no pre-correction v0.2 cache reused. Pre-correction and v0.1 snapshots opened read-only only for comparison.

independent_check_passed_meaning: Numerical computations and re-scores agree; explicit failed release data-quality conditions are retained and not recoded as passes.
publication_state: Published Zenodo DOI and immutable HF tag commit, independently verified. No production action or release write performed.

redaction.note: Redacted copy of the manifest of the release-wide audit (run against release v0.2.0, whose 107 graph files are byte-identical to v0.2.1). See audit/EXCLUDED.md and audit/release_audit/REDACTION_REGISTER.json.
redaction.release_docs_note: artifact/script/report hashes are of the PUBLISHED (redacted/edited) files, not of the originals

restrictions: No production access, paid model calls, dataset mutation, model-prompt/serving/retrieval inspection, deployment or release publication. Only audit-owned copies/derived caches/artifacts were written.

companion_pr9.tests: tests/test_evidence_map.py: 8 passed on PR head and again on main after merge

v023_lanes.description: Audit lanes for release v0.2.1: build + census, trial-landscape rerun, MedlinePlus English-only topic table, evidence maps, osteosarcoma hierarchy example, final paper numbers, headline numbers. Local DuckDB over the 107 release graph files only.
v023_lanes.restrictions: No production access, no paid model calls, no rights-reserved annotation-layer files. The only network use is downloading the public release files and reading the public Hugging Face / Zenodo record metadata (audit/scripts/fetch_release.py, verify_zenodo_bundles.py). No release file was changed.

rules.check_tags: 40-name NLM check-tag list never used as query, matched or expansion descriptor.
rules.full_expansion: descriptor + HAS_BROADER_ANCESTOR descendants (tree-number precise in this release).
rules.populations: with_stubs and without_stubs; stubs = Article lunasai_layer ctgov_identity_only (578,177), removed as map Articles and as citers. In v0.2.1 stubs have no pub_types, HAS_MESH or CITES, so MeSH-reached Article results are identical in both populations.
rules.self_citations: CITES with subject = object removed (24,044 edges).
